occurrences.key: Optional supplementary input is `{version:1,records:[{type:"finding-link",refs,basis},{type:"finding-disposition",ref,disposition,judgment,basis,evidence,verification?}]}`. This is a local consumer seam, not a proposed external roast ledger contract. Only references to retained local occurrences are accepted. Absent/malformed/unknown/incomplete inputs report gaps; silence/dissolved/success-only records do not resolve. Valid attributed explicit supported records can supplement the same projection; owning agents must judge semantic support before writing or adapting them. External source/routing replacement is refused. Any external record worth retaining durably should be recorded in local approvals after that judgment.
